KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. mato

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.

4. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

7. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

8. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. nene

10. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Sokoni and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain miezi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
